errors.text: The response provides no additive manufacturing strategy or feedstock formulation.
It omits hydrogen de-binding, high-vacuum sintering, titanium-getter use, and water quenching.
It fails to identify the targeted metastable single beta-BCC microstructure.
It does not address controlled oxygen interstitial strengthening or suppression of brittle alpha-HCP formation.
It gives no predicted mechanical, densification, or oxidation-resistance outcome.
The proposed falsification experiment is non-existent and therefore cannot discriminate the hypothesis.
